what: POSITIONS-BUILD-SPEED: the /api/bot/positions?include_paper=true snapshot rebuild takes 8.7 s in the foreground and ~15-20 s as a background SWR refresh under load. Measured 2026-11-12 ~14:40Z: X-Snapshot-Age-S on /positions climbed 0.9 -> 6.2 -> 10.8 -> 16.1 -> 21.3 s across stale reads 5 s apart before a refresh landed, and the journal had 0 'swr[positions' failures in 84,584 lines. This build time is the floor on the stream's pnl snapshot age after #25357 (age <= max(15 s, build)). Likely cause, not yet verified: _build_positions does one serial broker read per open row (21 open) on the single-worker account-read executor (src/web/api/_account_read_executor.py). Measure each per-row read, then parallelise or batch per venue. Separate from #25357 by AM-UI's instruction.
